collection.title: VW Passat Saloon 1996 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Passat Saloon 1996 to 2002 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
